name: Gerrard
description: The true heir to Urza's Legacy who completed it aboard the Weatherlight.

description_citations.text: "Yawgmoth". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Gerrard returns to the Weatherlight as captain in Sisay's absence after serving in the Benalish army.
timeline.quote: Now, after serving nobly in the Benalish army, he has returned to the *Weatherlight* to serve as captain in Sisay's absence

citation.text: Gerrard (Vanguard Series, 1997), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Karn accidentally takes a life while protecting the young Gerrard and vows never to kill again.
timeline.quote: Karn accidentally took the life of another.

citation.text: Karn (Vanguard Series, 1997), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Mirri rejoins Gerrard aboard the Weatherlight as his unofficial first mate.
timeline.quote: she rejoined Gerrard aboard the *Weatherlight* as his unofficial first mate

citation.text: Mirri (Vanguard Series, 1997), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Sisay undertakes a quest for the Legacy and continues it when Gerrard abandons it.
timeline.quote: She continued this quest even when Gerrard, heir to the Legacy, chose to abandon it.

citation.text: Sisay (Vanguard Series, 1997), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Volrath stole Gerrard's Legacy and sold it off piece by piece.
timeline.quote: Volrath stole Gerrard's Legacy and rose to power selling it off piece by piece.

citation.text: Volrath (Vanguard Series, 1997), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Multani taught Gerrard, Mirri and Rofellos to hone spellcasting alongside physical discipline.
timeline.quote: Multani taught Gerrard, Mirri, and Rofellos to hone their spellcasting in tandem with more physical disciplines

citation.text: Multani (Vanguard Series, 1997), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Oracle believes Gerrard to be the Korvecdal.
timeline.quote: She believes Gerrard to be the *Korvecdal*, the one who will unite the people of Rath against Volrath's tyranny.

citation.text: Oracle (Vanguard Series, 1997), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Sidar Kondo raised Gerrard alongside his son Vuel, who became malicious.
timeline.quote: Vuel's bitterness led him to become an equally devastating force of malice.

citation.text: Sidar Kondo (Vanguard Series, 1997), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Starke lies to Gerrard that he had to kill, and pledges loyalty.
timeline.quote: "I killed him because I had to," Starke lied to Gerrard. "But now I pledge my loyalty to you."

citation.text: Debt of Loyalty (Weatherlight, 1997), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Sisay declares the Lord of the Wastes must be destroyed.
timeline.quote: "The Lord of the Wastes must be destroyed; I am bound to this destiny by the chains of fate. If only Gerrard would see his part."

citation.text: Mana Chains (Weatherlight, 1997), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Gerrard threatens a gatekeeper to pass the gate.
timeline.quote: "There are two ways for me to pass this gate. One involves you remaining conscious."

citation.text: Abyssal Gatekeeper (Weatherlight, 1997), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: The Weatherlight banks as an aboroth rises to crush a lone rider.
timeline.quote: The *Weatherlight* banked sharply as the colossal beast rose up to crush the lone rider.

citation.text: Aboroth (Weatherlight, 1997), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Gerrard uses the Thran Forge to strengthen the aboroth, calling out to the elves.
timeline.quote: "This will work," Gerrard called to the elves as he used the forge to strengthen the aboroth, "but if it doesn't, we won't survive to care."

citation.text: Thran Forge (Weatherlight, 1997), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Karn vows not to take another's life though he would die for Gerrard.
timeline.quote: "Although I would give my life to protect Gerrard, my conscience will not let me take another's. There are many who would not hesitate."

citation.text: Steel Golem (Weatherlight, 1997), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Gerrard says he sneezed and a drake bolted.
timeline.quote: "I sneezed, and it bolted."

citation.text: Timid Drake (Weatherlight, 1997), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Gerrard draws his sword and tells his crew the enemy should have brought a second ship.
timeline.quote: They should have brought a second ship!

citation.text: Gerrard's Battle Cry (Tempest, 1997), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Gerrard orders slivers kept at sword's length, but their talons grow longer.
timeline.quote: Keep them at sword's length!

citation.text: Talon Sliver (Tempest, 1997), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Orim tells Gerrard he must work hard yet appear effortless like the drake.
timeline.quote: You *must* do the same.

citation.text: Wind Drake (Tempest, 1997), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Gerrard vanishes into the maw of trees as Hanna mourns.
timeline.quote: As Gerrard's form vanished into the maw of trees

citation.text: Abandon Hope (Tempest, 1997), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Gerrard asks Orim whether it is too late for prayer as sludge shifts in the Death Pits.
timeline.quote: it's a little too late for prayer, isn't it?

citation.text: Death Pits of Rath (Tempest, 1997), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Volrath berates Greven for failing to capture Gerrard.
timeline.quote: Tell me again why you failed to capture Gerrard

citation.text: Fevered Convulsions (Tempest, 1997), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Gerrard and Greven approach each other while moggs flee.
timeline.quote: As Gerrard and Greven neared each other

citation.text: No Quarter (Tempest, 1997), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Eladamri's mushroom wine makes Gerrard sick.
timeline.quote: The mushroom wine made Gerrard's head spin

citation.text: Eladamri's Vineyard (Tempest, 1997), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Gerrard escapes as a wurm eats merfolk.
timeline.quote: As Gerrard made his escape

citation.text: Rootbreaker Wurm (Tempest, 1997), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Squee clutches his toy as horrors close in on Gerrard.
timeline.quote: Squee trembled and clutched his toy for comfort.

citation.text: Squee's Toy (Tempest, 1997), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Gerrard unmasks the dead shapeshifter Vuel who had worn Volrath's features and calls it practice.
timeline.quote: I'll count this one as practice.

citation.text: Scapegoat (Stronghold, 1998), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Gerrard tells Volrath he now gets to die.
timeline.quote: Now you get to die.

citation.text: Smite (Stronghold, 1998), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Gerrard hesitates, looking up at the enemy ship, and the future changes.
timeline.quote: Gerrard hesitated, looking up at the enemy ship.

citation.text: Hesitation (Stronghold, 1998), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Gerrard comments on the bottomless pit.
timeline.quote: I'm sure it came with the place.

citation.text: Bottomless Pit (Stronghold, 1998), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Gerrard tells Crovax he will tire before his pain does.
timeline.quote: you will tire before it does.

citation.text: Megrim (Stronghold, 1998), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Gerrard studies the globe and realizes it shows Dominaria.
timeline.quote: This is Dominaria!

citation.text: Invasion Plans (Stronghold, 1998), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Gerrard did not expect a fight from the building itself.
timeline.quote: I expected a fight, but I didn't expect it from the building itself.

citation.text: Ensnaring Bridge (Stronghold, 1998), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Sisay, injured, asks about her ship and Gerrard assures her it is intact.
timeline.quote: Intact," Gerrard reassured her

citation.text: Fugue (Exodus, 1998), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Greven il-Vec threatens to flay Gerrard.
timeline.quote: I will flay the skin from your flesh and the flesh from your bones and scrape your bones dry.

citation.text: Hatred (Exodus, 1998), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Gerrard bests Greven by sacrificing defense.
timeline.quote: Only by sacrificing any semblance of defense could Gerrard best Greven.

citation.text: Maniacal Rage (Exodus, 1998), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Gerrard recalls Benalish knights being called armored lightning.
timeline.quote: We called them 'armored lightning.'

citation.text: Benalish Knight (Anthologies, 1998), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Gerrard says no one can get near the island of Avenant.
timeline.quote: you can't even get near the island of Avenant.

citation.text: Heavy Ballista (Classic Sixth Edition, 1999), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Gerrard calls himself the storm before the calm.
timeline.quote: Just think of me as the storm before the calm.

citation.text: Serenity (Classic Sixth Edition, 1999), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Cho-Manno tells Orim he did not choose his role and neither did Gerrard.
timeline.quote: I did not choose my role, Orim," said Cho-Manno patiently

citation.text: Ivory Mask (Mercadian Masques, 1999), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Orim condemns Gerrard and he offers no defense.
timeline.quote: Gerrard offered no defense to Orim's condemnation

citation.text: Renounce (Mercadian Masques, 1999), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Gerrard was the Mercadian soldiers' hero; they stumbled when he left.
timeline.quote: Gerrard was the Mercadian soldiers' greatest hero; they followed him blindly.

citation.text: Cowardice (Mercadian Masques, 1999), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Gerrard realizes the woman rescued from Rath is not helpless.
timeline.quote: Gerrard realized that the helpless woman they'd rescued from Rath was nothing of the sort.

citation.text: Liability (Mercadian Masques, 1999), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Gerrard tells Sisay the ceremonial guards are disciplined but could not fight.
timeline.quote: They couldn't fight their way out of a broom closet, but they've got discipline.

citation.text: Ceremonial Guard (Mercadian Masques, 1999), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Gerrard crashes and thinks it is not the start he hoped for.
timeline.quote: Gerrard shook his head as the ground rushed to meet him.

citation.text: Crash (Mercadian Masques, 1999), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Gerrard ends up fighting the irregulars he trained.
timeline.quote: Had Gerrard realized he'd end up fighting against them

citation.text: Gerrard's Irregulars (Mercadian Masques, 1999), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Gerrard and Sisay run deeper into the mountain unwilling to leave without the Weatherlight and crew.
timeline.quote: Neither of them intended to leave Mercadia without the *Weatherlight* and its crew.

citation.text: Tremor (Mercadian Masques, 1999), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Cho-Manno resolves to ally with Gerrard to free his people.
timeline.quote: Cho-Manno knew he had no choice but to ally with Gerrard.

citation.text: Uphill Battle (Mercadian Masques, 1999), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Gerrard recalls the living wreath Mirri laid for her kin.
timeline.quote: recalling the living wreath Mirri laid for her dead kin.

citation.text: Revive (Mercadian Masques, 1999), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Sisay is restored, the Legacy recovered, and the Weatherlight sails for Dominaria.
timeline.quote: the *Weatherlight* was sailing home to Dominaria.

citation.text: Tranquility (Mercadian Masques, 1999), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Gerrard says he used up all his luck in one fall.
timeline.quote: I think I used up all my good luck and all my bad luck in the same fall.

citation.text: Broken Fall (Battle Royale Box Set, 1999), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Gerrard smiles as the Phyrexian portals disappear behind the Weatherlight.
timeline.quote: Gerrard savored a grim smile as the Phyrexian portals disappeared behind the *Weatherlight*.

citation.text: Distorting Wake (Invasion, 2000), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Tsabo Tavoc and Gerrard face off.
timeline.quote: "I think I can kill you," replied Gerrard.

citation.text: Dueling Grounds (Invasion, 2000), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Eladamri returns to help Gerrard, repaying the saving of his people.
timeline.quote: You helped save my people from a Phyrexian fate.

citation.text: Heroes' Reunion (Invasion, 2000), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Ertai taunts Gerrard about the crew's rescue.
timeline.quote: I'm sure the crew will come to your rescue as quickly as they came to mine.

citation.text: Ertai's Trickery (Planeshift, 2001), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Gerrard rejects Yawgmoth's false Hanna.
timeline.quote: You're not my Hanna!

citation.text: Jilt (Apocalypse, 2001), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Gerrard accepts his destiny.
timeline.quote: Don't mourn for me. This is my destiny.

citation.text: Vindicate (Apocalypse, 2001), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Gerrard tells a foe they will tire before their pain does.
timeline.quote: You can run from your pain, but you will tire before it does.

citation.text: Megrim (Ninth Edition, 2005), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: In Benalia, Pol Cordel tells Gerrard that a Talruum has arrived aboard a flying ship, and Gerrard guesses Sisay has come for him.
timeline.quote: "You think she's come looking for me."

citation.text: "Maelstrom" by Michael G. Ryan. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Feb 2007.

timeline.summary: Gerrard recalls that chasing the Legacy cost the lives of friends and is why he left the Weatherlight.
timeline.quote: chasing after the Legacy cost the lives of friends.

citation.text: "Maelstrom" by Michael G. Ryan. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Feb 2007.

timeline.summary: Cordel's argument persuades Gerrard to go and see the docks.
timeline.quote: All right then. A convincing argument at last. Which docks?

citation.text: "Maelstrom" by Michael G. Ryan. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Feb 2007.

timeline.summary: Starke offers Maraxus the woman who knows where Gerrard is, claiming she can draw Gerrard from hiding, and Maraxus orders him to bring her.
timeline.quote: "Bring her," it said suddenly.

citation.text: "Maelstrom" by Michael G. Ryan. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Feb 2007.

timeline.summary: Gerrard hears Tahngarth roaring at a missionary of the Church of Angelfire on the docks and runs to calm him.
timeline.quote: "Uh oh," Gerrard murmured, and broke into a run.

citation.text: "Maelstrom" by Michael G. Ryan. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Feb 2007.

timeline.summary: Gerrard talks Tahngarth out of killing the missionary, and the two are reunited.
timeline.quote: "Easy, Tahngarth," he murmured, taking the Talruum's arm.

citation.text: "Maelstrom" by Michael G. Ryan. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Feb 2007.

timeline.summary: Tahngarth tells Gerrard they came to find him because something terrible has happened to Sisay.
timeline.quote: something terrible has happened.

citation.text: "Maelstrom" by Michael G. Ryan. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Feb 2007.

timeline.summary: Sisay predicts that Gerrard will never be free of the Legacy.
timeline.quote: He'll never be free of the Legacy. He just doesn't know it yet.

citation.text: "Maelstrom" by Michael G. Ryan. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Feb 2007.

timeline.summary: Gerrard decides to return to the Weatherlight the next morning, with Cordel arguing he should help his friends.
timeline.quote: Tomorrow morning I'm going back to the Weatherlight

citation.text: "Maelstrom" by Michael G. Ryan. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Feb 2007.

timeline.summary: Gerrard leaves his hourglass pendant, the only part of the Legacy he kept, in Cordel's keeping.
timeline.quote: This belonged to my parents.

citation.text: "Maelstrom" by Michael G. Ryan. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Feb 2007.

timeline.summary: The Weatherlight, with Gerrard aboard, sets sail from Benalia.
timeline.quote: The following morning, the Weatherlight , with Gerrard aboard, set sail from Benalia.

citation.text: "Maelstrom" by Michael G. Ryan. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Feb 2007.

timeline.summary: Starke decides to seek allies after learning Gerrard is no longer aboard the Weatherlight.
timeline.quote: It's time I sought allies.

citation.text: "Torrent" by Michael G. Ryan. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Feb 2007.

timeline.summary: Gerrard, Tahngarth and Crovax, who rescued Starke from Maraxus's camp, walk through a canyon and Tahngarth carries the weakened Starke.
timeline.quote: since the trio had rescued Starke from Maraxus of Keld's camp

citation.text: "Torrent" by Michael G. Ryan. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Feb 2007.

timeline.summary: Starke whispers to Gerrard that Maraxus has a secret that might kill him.
timeline.quote: "A secret that might kill him."

citation.text: "Torrent" by Michael G. Ryan. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Feb 2007.

timeline.summary: Maraxus and his ogre platoon find the sleeping group at dawn and attack, demanding Starke.
timeline.quote: "Give me the traitor," Maraxus demanded of Gerrard

citation.text: "Torrent" by Michael G. Ryan. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Feb 2007.

timeline.summary: Gerrard sends Tahngarth, Crovax and Starke to the ship to leave him alone against Maraxus, whose strength depends on those around him.
timeline.quote: that you draw your strength from whatever's around you, whoever's near. Look around. You're alone.

citation.text: "Torrent" by Michael G. Ryan. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Feb 2007.

timeline.summary: Gerrard duels Maraxus and wounds him, and Maraxus's strength drains away.
timeline.quote: Gerrard landed a clean cut across the warlord's sword arm.

citation.text: "Torrent" by Michael G. Ryan. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Feb 2007.

timeline.summary: Starke admits he killed Maraxus to stop him exposing the betrayal of Sisay, and offers to lead Gerrard to Rath for his daughter's freedom.
timeline.quote: I can lead you to Rath,

citation.text: "Torrent" by Michael G. Ryan. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Feb 2007.

timeline.summary: Gerrard says he has no reason to trust Starke but needs him to reach Rath, and will watch him constantly.
timeline.quote: I have no reason at all to trust you, Starke.

citation.text: "Torrent" by Michael G. Ryan. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Feb 2007.

timeline.summary: Gerrard threatens an Abyssal Gatekeeper that passing the gate involves the gatekeeper's staying conscious or not.
timeline.quote: There are two ways for me to pass this gate. One involves you remaining conscious.

citation.text: Abyssal Gatekeeper (Duel Decks: Divine vs. Demonic, 2009), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Gerrard looks for the source of a mysterious pulse and slivers boil forth from the crevasses.
timeline.quote: at that moment the slivers boiled forth from the crevasses.

citation.text: Heart Sliver (Premium Deck Series: Slivers, 2009), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Sidar Kondo is killed by his own son Vuel, consumed by envy.
timeline.quote: Kondo died by his own son's hands.

citation.work: It's Time to Talk Commander (2016 Edition)!
citation.text: "It's Time to Talk Commander (2016 Edition)!" by Magic Creative Team. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Oct 2016.

timeline.summary: Tiana is moved by the Weatherlight's skeleton, recognizing it as Gerrard's blade.
timeline.quote: It's Gerrard's blade in the portraits.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 3" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Mar 2018.

timeline.summary: Tiana sees the portrait of Gerrard and his strange spear.
timeline.quote: The knowledge she had been born with told her that the man with the brown hair and goatee

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 4" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Apr 2018.

timeline.summary: Urza leads planeswalkers to Phyrexia, and Gerrard and Urza are forced to fight repeatedly in an arena, revived by Yawgmoth, until Urza is decapitated and Gerrard escapes with the head.
timeline.quote: Eventually, Urza is decapitated and Gerrard escapes with the head

citation.text: "Apocalypse", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Gerrard lands in the Stronghold throne room where a crazed Crovax stands over Squee.
timeline.quote: with a crazed Crovax standing over the broken form of Squee

citation.text: "Apocalypse", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Yawgmoth arrives and the final battle begins; channeling the Null Moon's mana fails to kill him.
timeline.quote: but fail to kill him

citation.text: "Apocalypse", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Urza has Gerrard place his powerstone eyes in Karn's chest, completing the Legacy; light eradicates Yawgmoth's essence.
timeline.quote: Light spreads all over the world, eradicating Yawgmoth's essence.

citation.text: "Apocalypse", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Gerrard and Urza die in the Weapon's activation, the Weatherlight crashes, and Karn becomes a planeswalker.
timeline.quote: Gerrard and Urza do not survive the Weapon's activation

citation.text: "Apocalypse", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Yawgmoth sets Gerrard and Urza to fight in an arena filled with his avatars, promising to grant the winner's wish.
timeline.quote: Their new master creates an arena which he fills with countless avatars of himself

citation.text: "Apocalypse (novel)", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Gerrard wins the duel by decapitating Urza, rejects Yawgmoth's reward, sees through a Hanna-avatar, and is flung out of Phyrexia.
timeline.quote: Gerrard wins the duel by decapitating Urza.

citation.text: "Apocalypse (novel)", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Gerrard lands in the Stronghold throne room, reunites with Squee, and they defeat Phyrexian troops; Ertai summons Crovax back.
timeline.quote: Ertai realizes he can't defeat Gerrard and summons Crovax back to the Stronghold.

citation.text: "Apocalypse (novel)", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Gerrard kills Crovax, Squee fries Ertai, and the Dominarian forces escape on the Weatherlight as lava engulfs the Stronghold.
timeline.quote: Gerrard kills Crovax with an axe

citation.text: "Apocalypse (novel)", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Weatherlight launches the Legacy Weapon, Yawgmoth seizes the ship, and Karn, Urza and Gerrard merge into a radiant light that defeats Yawgmoth.
timeline.quote: the light defeated Yawgmoth

citation.text: "Apocalypse (novel)", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Weatherlight enters Rath's atmosphere to rescue Sisay, led by Gerrard.
timeline.quote: Skyship Weatherlight entered its dangerous atmosphere far above the desert of deadly flowstone

citation.text: "Assault on Rath", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Greven's Predator ambushes the Weatherlight and Greven battles Gerrard.
timeline.quote: Greven and his crew ambushed the Weatherlight, boarding the ship and engaging in a fierce personal battle with Gerrard.

citation.text: "Assault on Rath", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Vhati fires on the Weatherlight, capsizing it and sending Gerrard tumbling from the deck.
timeline.quote: Gerrard was sent tumbling from the deck, falling through a long stretch of open air.

citation.text: "Assault on Rath", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Selenia catches Gerrard mid-air but he wrests free and falls into the forest canopy.
timeline.quote: Gerrard was caught mid-air by Selenia

citation.text: "Assault on Rath", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Gerrard returns with Eladamri and the Oracle, having been saved by Selenia, and plans to rescue the captives and reclaim the Legacy.
timeline.quote: revealing that he had been saved by Selenia before managing to escape.

citation.text: "Assault on Rath", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Gerrard realizes Rath is absorbing Dominaria, then defeats Sisay and Takara set against him by Volrath.
timeline.quote: Gerrard realized that Rath was absorbing Dominaria itself.

citation.text: "Assault on Rath", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Mirri sacrifices herself fighting Crovax so Gerrard can escape.
timeline.quote: she sacrificed herself, allowing Gerrard to live.

citation.text: "Assault on Rath", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Weatherlight crosses the portal boosted by the Skyshaper, leaving Ertai behind on Rath.
timeline.quote: he was unable to save him, leaving him behind on Rath.

citation.text: "Assault on Rath", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Yawgmoth begins emerging through the portal in the Stronghold; the allies flee on the Weatherlight and Gerrard plugs the volcano with a plague ship.
timeline.quote: Yawgmoth began emerging through the planar portal in Stronghold's throne room.

citation.text: "Astor", section "The Battle of Urborg". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Weatherlight crew crashes a plague ship into the volcano, but Yawgmoth rises unhindered.
timeline.quote: Yawgmoth rose effortlessly up around the plug, unhindered.

citation.text: "Black Cloud of Death", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Sisay rejects Urza's plan to shatter the Legacy artifacts and Gerrard.
timeline.quote: Captain Sisay rejected this, declaring it madness

citation.text: "Black Cloud of Death", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Gerrard places Urza's Powerstone eyes in Karn's chest, completing the Legacy Weapon.
timeline.quote: Gerrard removed Urza’s Powerstone eyes
